categories.main_business_segments: Dongguan Yiheda Automation Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, production, and sales of factory automation (FA) components, providing a one-stop supply of automation parts. Its product portfolio includes linear motion parts, transmission parts, pneumatic components, aluminum profiles and accessories, industrial frame structural parts, machined parts, small mechanical parts, electronic and electrical parts, and customized non-standard parts. The company also operates an e-commerce platform for online selection and procurement of automation components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes standardized design and classification of automation parts based on application scenarios, integrating self-manufacturing, OEM supply, and centralized procurement. It employs agile manufacturing, digital product databases, ERP systems, and intelligent production lines including automated quoting, programming, and flexible production to meet small-batch, high-frequency, and diverse order demands. R&D focuses on product standardization, modularization, and innovation in materials and mechanical structures, supported by over 600 patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yiheda serves primarily automation equipment manufacturers and end-users across diverse industries such as 3C electronics, new energy lithium batteries, automotive, photovoltaics, semiconductors, industrial robotics, military, medical, laser, food, and logistics. The company caters to approximately 40,000 customers, including engineers and procurement departments, providing tailored solutions for their long-tail, small-batch, and customized component needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Dongguan, Guangdong Province, China, with subsidiaries in Shenzhen, Suzhou, Hubei, Shandong, Hong Kong, and Japan. Its business covers over 30 countries and regions across Asia, North America, Europe, South America, and Oceania. Domestically, it has strong market presence in South China, East China, Central China, North China, and Southwest China, with ongoing expansion in regions with robust downstream industry demand.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yiheda operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automation equipment supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and supply of automation components. It integrates upstream supplier resources through OEM and centralized procurement and serves downstream automation equipment manufacturers and end-users, providing one-stop procurement services and supply chain management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on building 'extreme product strength' by enhancing product quality, delivery speed, and customization capabilities. It prioritizes standardization and modularization of non-standard parts, digital transformation, and platform ecosystem development. R&D efforts target expanding product categories, improving product performance and reliability, and leveraging AI and intelligent manufacturing technologies to reduce costs and accelerate innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Yiheda generates revenue primarily through the sale of automation components and equipment. Sales are conducted via direct sales channels, including offline sales supported by sales engineers and online sales through its e-commerce platform. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance of products, with pricing based on product catalogs, online quotations, and contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic and international automation parts suppliers, including MISUMI, which holds a global first-mover advantage in one-stop supply. Yiheda is positioned as a leading domestic one-stop supplier with competitive advantages in product standardization, supply chain management, local service, and digital capabilities. The industry is fragmented with many small-scale manufacturers, and Yiheda maintains a leading position in China’s FA components market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yiheda reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.5 billion, a 13.08% decrease from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 404 million, down 25.87%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 4.67 billion, with net assets of RMB 4.11 billion. Despite short-term revenue decline due to market fluctuations, cash flow from operations increased by 93.56%, reflecting strong operational cash generation. The company has steadily expanded its product portfolio and customer base over 14 years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yiheda’s value proposition centers on providing a comprehensive, standardized, and reliable one-stop procurement platform for factory automation components, addressing the long-tail, small-batch, and diverse needs of customers. Its competitive differentiation lies in its extensive product range, rapid delivery capabilities (90% of standard parts shipped within 3 days), quality control, digital tools for design and procurement, and localized customer service. The company leverages platform integration and supply chain collaboration to reduce customer design and procurement time and costs, enhancing customer trust and loyalty.
